Software Engineer I — Full Stack (Bengaluru)
Company: CloudNest Technologies

About the role
You will build customer-facing features across our React frontend and Node.js services,
working with product managers and senior engineers.

Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain features using React and Node.js
- Design REST APIs and data models
- Write unit and integration tests
- Participate in code reviews and on-call rotations

Requirements
- 0-2 years of experience or strong internship experience
- Strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and OOP
- Proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript
- Experience with React and Node.js
- Solid SQL skills with PostgreSQL or MySQL
- Understanding of REST APIs and Git

Nice to have
- Docker and Kubernetes
- AWS
- Redis caching
- System design basics
